deadline.bestiary.anima: Lost souls. Invisible except to the camera or UV light. They leave an unmistakable chill.
deadline.bestiary.llorona: She drowned her children in the river and has searched for them ever since. Her weeping lies: when it sounds far, she is close. Looking at her makes her scream.
deadline.bestiary.monja: An expelled nun who made a pact. She only moves in darkness. Light freezes and burns her.
deadline.bestiary.muneca: Possessed porcelain. It only moves when nobody is looking.
deadline.bestiary.payaso: The star entertainer of Happy World Park. He never left. While the music box plays, he hides. When it stops, he is in front of you.
deadline.bestiary.poseida: Lucia played with a spirit board. Something answered. She climbs walls, levitates and cannot be jarred: only exorcised.
deadline.bestiary.sombra: Seen by those who have lost their minds. Look at it and it disappears. Look away and it comes closer.
deadline.bestiary.wendigo: A hunter who ate human flesh to survive the winter. It mimics the voices of its victims. It fears fire.
deadline.case.bosque.hint: There is a stone circle north of the campsite.
deadline.case.bosque.msg.0: A group of campers vanished in the Black Forest. The tents are torn apart and the tracks belong to no animal.
deadline.case.bosque.msg.1: We heard Martin calling for help between the trees. We went looking for him... but Martin was right there with us.
deadline.case.bosque.msg.2: Something huge with antlers walks on two legs through the forest. It ate my dogs. It is not a deer.
deadline.case.bosque.msg.3: Hello? Help! I am lost in the forest! ...hello? hello? hello?
deadline.case.casa.hint: Lucia's doll is in the basement.
deadline.case.casa.msg.0: Please... my daughter Lucia is not herself. She speaks languages she never learned. Last night we found her walking on the ceiling.
deadline.case.casa.msg.1: I visited the Morales family. What I saw in that room is not an illness. We need an exorcist. Today.
deadline.case.casa.msg.2: There is screaming every night at the Morales house. The girl's dolls keep showing up in my garden.
deadline.case.casa.msg.3: The lights turn off by themselves. My daughter laughs in the basement... but the basement is locked.
deadline.case.casa.msg.4: ...hello? They won't let me out. Come play with me. I'm in my room.
deadline.case.convento.hint: There is a crypt under the altar.
deadline.case.convento.msg.0: There are only three sisters in this convent. At night there are four. The fourth has no face.
deadline.case.convento.msg.1: I need discretion. At Saint Agnes the crosses are inverted every morning. A novice has disappeared.
deadline.case.convento.msg.2: I saw her in the corridor when the candles went out. I turned on my flashlight and she was gone. I turned it off... and she was right beside me.
deadline.case.parque.hint: The music comes from the circus tent.
deadline.case.parque.msg.0: Happy World Park closed twenty years ago. Last night the carousel started spinning on its own and a music box played.
deadline.case.parque.msg.1: A clown gave me a red balloon through my window. He says he is coming for me tomorrow.
deadline.case.parque.msg.2: I was investigating why the park closed. Every former employee I found is dead. The same clown is in every photo.
deadline.case.parque.msg.3: (a music box... a laugh)... want a balloon?
deadline.case.rio.hint: Something floats at the end of the pier.
deadline.case.rio.msg.0: Every night I hear a woman weeping by the river. Last night the crying sounded far away... and she was right next to my boat.
deadline.case.rio.msg.1: My son came back from the river soaking wet and shaking. He says a lady in white asked him if he was her son.
deadline.case.rio.msg.2: Three missing this week at the River of Laments. All of them heard weeping first. Nobody wants to go.
deadline.case.rio.msg.3: ...oh, my children!... where are my children?...
deadline.msg.anchor_purified: §b✟ Object purified.§r The entity is now vulnerable.
deadline.msg.anchored: §8Something protects it... find its cursed object.
deadline.msg.case_failed: §4Case failed:§r %s. The entity is still there.
deadline.msg.needs_exorcism: §cIt will not fit in a jar. It needs an exorcism.
deadline.msg.stage_exorcise: §6It is bound!§r Hold the §bBook of Rites§r near it to exorcise it.
deadline.msg.stage_jar: §6It is weakened!§r Trap it with the §bSpirit Jar§r.
deadline.msg.welcome: §4[DEAD LINE]§r Your phone is on. Keep it close: someone is going to call.
deadline.objective.0: Find the cursed object and purify it with holy water
deadline.objective.1: The entity is vulnerable: weaken it
deadline.objective.2: Trap it with the Spirit Jar
deadline.objective.2x: Exorcise it with the Book of Rites
deadline.phone.locked: You have not met it yet.
